title: Privacy notice
html:
Effective 2026-11-18. Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC operates Fernwork at fernwork.zeabur.app. This notice covers the information we handle when you browse, buy goods or contact us. For privacy questions, use PumpCadle668@outlook.com or write to 36 W Michigan Ave, Battle Creek, MI 49017, USA.

Information we use

For an order, we use your name, contact details, billing and shipping addresses, order contents and transaction status. We use these details to take payment, deliver goods, issue refunds and answer order questions. Our payment processor receives the full card number, expiry and billing address. The payment information visible to our team is the last four digits, the card brand and the payment outcome.

For a support request, we use your messages and the order details you provide to investigate and reply.

When you visit the site we collect the pages you request and the device and browser type in our web server logs, for security and to see which pages are used. We do not run third-party analytics or advertising scripts on this store.

Who receives information

Our store and hosting are provided by Zeabur (hosting) and GitHub (source control). We provide the information required to process payments to our payment processor, and delivery information to the carrier. We do not sell your personal information.

Retention

We keep order and invoice records for as long as tax and accounting rules require, customer correspondence for up to two years, and consent records while they are needed to show what you agreed to. Server logs are kept for a short period and then overwritten.

Cookies

We use browser storage to keep your cart together and to remember recently viewed items. No advertising cookies are set on this store. You can clear storage in your browser; the cart is lost if you do.

Choices and requests

Our handling of browser privacy signals, including Global Privacy Control, is limited: with no advertising scripts, there is little to opt out of. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to obtain a copy of the personal information we hold, correct or delete it, or opt out of specific uses. Submit a request to PumpCadle668@outlook.com. For access or deletion requests we may ask for details needed to verify your identity. An authorised agent may contact us with evidence of authority. We will not discriminate against you for exercising a privacy right.

Security and changes

We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect your information and keep it only as long as needed. We may update this notice to reflect changes in our business or the law; the latest version is always on this page.
